# Circular-Economy = FALSE — Full Review

_Source: **prod** (Cloud SQL `signalscout-pg`) · Generated 2026-07-30 · **7,683** bills with `ce_relevant = false` across all jurisdictions._

Every out-of-scope bill is listed below, grouped by jurisdiction. The **Flagged** section up top surfaces rows whose title/description hit circular-economy keywords (EPR, recycling, packaging, solar/panel, decommission, e-waste, battery, take-back, etc.) — this is where a wrongly-excluded in-scope law (like the PA solar-decommissioning one) is most likely hiding. Review those first.

Columns: **Bill** · **Title** · **Status** · **Conf** = classifier confidence · **Src**. `id` in the anchor is the DB primary key.
